ValidationRule.description: Handles ownership changes for settlement records
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ISCHANGED(OwnerId), OR( AND($UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Settlement_Officer_Lead', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName <> 'Settlements_Queue', Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName <> 'Settlement_Officer_Lead', Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName <> 'Settlement_Officer' ), AND($UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Settlement_Officer', PRIORVALUE( Owner_Name__c) <> 'Settlements Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName <> 'Settlements_Queue', OwnerId <> $User.Id )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please assign ownership to a valid user or queue.
